scope: DDL execution and inventory verification for the selected 12,500-file cohort

converted_ddl_execution.method: Each converted DDL file executed in its own transaction and temporary test schema. Catalog counts were inspected before rollback.
converted_ddl_execution.postgres: PostgreSQL 18.6 (PGlite 0.5.15) on wasm32-unknown-emscripten, compiled by emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.13 (e13ee988ce3d87a738dd8f3661d02223308c412a), 32-bit

limits: The database test executes the converted DDL; it is not a workload benchmark or a proof of mapping equivalence.
The 728 native files are retained unchanged; the DDL execution results in this report cover the 11,772 converted files only.
No training or performance measurements were produced.
